title: I'll Be Seeing You, after Rod Stewart

details.title: I'll Be Seeing You
details.lead: Rod Stewart's sung line, played straight on the trumpet, an octave above where he sings it, in his key: concert C4 to G5 (written D4 to A5).
facts: I'll Be Seeing You, as Rod Stewart sings it on the recording you sent
Rod's voice, read note by note and straightened
G♭ concert, A♭ for the trumpet
The song as Rod sings it, the verse first, with rests where the band plays alone
